profile.reading: The registry operator name Centersquare and the domain centersquaredc.com resolve, via a same brand redirect, to csquare.com, indicating Centersquare and Csquare are current names for the same operator; this registry separately lists a Csquare operator record as well. The operator own site states it runs 80 colocation data centers across 30 markets, totaling 3.5 million square feet of space and more than 500 megawatts of power capacity, serving over 2,000 customers and more than 200 network and technology service providers, and describes itself as having operated for over 20 years, implying founding in the early 2000s. Its confirmed markets include Northern Virginia, Chicago Illinois, Phoenix Arizona, the Dallas Fort Worth area of Texas, Seattle Washington, the New York and New Jersey metro area, and Atlanta Georgia, matching every state where this registry carries a Centersquare facility. The company is headquartered at 3100 Olympus Boulevard, Suite 510, Coppell, Texas. No detailed founding history, prior company names, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular row were confirmed in available sourcing this session.
